|joke=The title plays on Paul Simon's 1977 song "Slip Slidin' Away".<ref name="wp-slip">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slip_Slidin%27_Away Slip Slidin' Away], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008230229/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Slip_Slidin%27_Away Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref> The lore puns on two meanings of "shaft": Luke falls down Cloud City's central shaft after his duel with Vader,<ref name="wp-esb">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Empire_Strikes_Back The Empire Strikes Back], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261023180200/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Empire_Strikes_Back Internet Archive], 23 October 2026.</ref> and "the shaft" is also slang for harsh or unfair treatment.<ref name="mw-shaft">[https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shaft shaft], Merriam-Webster Dictionary. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251229113508/https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/shaft Internet Archive], 29 December 2025.</ref> See [[Jokes#Slip Sliding Away|Jokes]].
